articleTitle: Grid Task Scheduling Based on Adaptive Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: On the basis of former work, this paper presents an improved ant colony algorithm, namely adaptive ant colony algorithm for grid task scheduling. In the proposed algorithm, the value of evaporation rate p is adaptively changed and a minimum value p<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub> is assigned. Thereby, the evaporation rate p is under control and will never be reduced to 0. Comparing experimental results with the original algorithm show that the proposed algorithm is more efficient both in task scheduling efficiency and resource load.

articleTitle: An Anatomy to SaaS Business Mode Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As a rapidly growing mode of software licensing contrast to traditional perpetual-use license, SaaS users buy subscriptions from software vendors. Two kinds of application infrastructure modes of software suppliers, SaaS (software as a service) and ASP (application service provider), were compared, and then combined with China's concrete conditions, main distinction between SaaS and ASP were stated briefly. The technique and infrastructure, product selection and service mode of SaaS were discussed in the paper. Advantages and disadvantages of SaaS business mode were analyzed. A conclusion is that SaaS mode could help software suppliers in China gain more and longer and contribute to china SME informatization.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation List Diversity of Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Recommender systems have emerged in the past several years as an effective way to help people cope with the problem of information overload. Most research up to this point has focused on improving the accuracy of recommender systems. However, considering the range of userpsilas interests covered, recommendation diversity is also important. In this paper we propose a novel topic diversity metric which explores hierarchical domain knowledge, and evaluate the recommendation diversity of the two most classic collaborative filtering (CF) algorithm with movielens dataset.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of RSA Algorithm in Java
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the concept of RSA algorithm, and presents the flaws of other existing implementations of RSA Algorithm in Java, thereby designs our improved implementation and analyzes the performance of our implementation. Wepsilave developed a piece of software for encrypting and decrypting text files.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Middle Frequency Embedded Digital Watermark Algorithm Based on the DCT Domain
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm of digital watermark embedding in the middle frequency adaptively based on the DCT domain. According to the energy of the block size after transforming, the algorithm can select the middle frequency coefficient adaptively to do embedding operation. Compared with traditional DCT domain fixed-point algorithm, it reachs a better balance of robust and watermark information hiding. The results show that, particularly in the JPEG compression attack, the algorithm which this paper presents can improve the signal-to-noise and the similarity than the traditional fixed-point algorithm.

articleTitle: Clustering Technology Application in e-Commerce Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This article analyses two kinds of information filtering technologies used in the e-commerce recommendation system: content-based filtering and collaborative filtering. On the foundation of collaborative filtering, we research the influential role of cluster technology to improve the recommendation system quality, to reduce the computation complexity, and to enhance the system real-time response speed.

articleTitle: A New Security Trust Model for Peer-to-Peer E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) electronic commerce greatly enhances the convenience and flexibility of e-business, but it also aggravates the risk and security threatening business activity. In order to prevent the vulnerable peers from involving in transaction and solve the trust problem of no-history record peers, this paper proposes a new trust model of P2P e-commerce, which is based on voting agreement. It can evaluate and predicate the actions of the other side according to the trading experience and the recommendation of the other peers. Simulations show that this model can more accurately evaluate the trading side of e-business, help users to select the reliable trading partner, reduce the risk of trading and validate the security, reliability and robust of P2P electronic commerce in transaction.

articleTitle: A Research on Related Questions of Chinese Food Cold Chain Development
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The questions on Chinese food cold chain are related to the stability of the social economy, people's quality of life, the health and the safety. It also affects the Chinese international fame. This article firstly introduces some theories of the food cold chain, then studies the questions which is in the Chinese food cold chain development, and analyzes deeply the reason of these questions, at last establishes a whole traceable food cold chain to direct the Chinese food cold chain development in the future.

articleTitle: Virtual Reconstruction of FouGuang Temple Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Virtual reality is a combination of image processing, computer graphics, computer vision, human-comp interaction and so on. With virtual reality, we have made a virtual reconstruction to FouGuang temple. The process of virtual reconstruction consists of data acquiring, modeling, render and real-time browsing system designing. Our system selects single sight of FouGuang temple as example, supporting the browsing modes including free browsing. It provides a beneficial attempt to applying of virtual reality technology to the protection of Chinese history architecture.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Based Agents over P2P Network
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Electronic commerce technology is more and more present and people are getting connected together. Companies and users want to automate their task and discover new business opportunities. Many standards and initiatives have been already proposed. Most of them focus on business-to-business protocol definition. Unfortunately, the commercial solutions provided today do not provide sufficient support for integration. Software agents have already been proposed as a key technology for connecting people and adding new features in electronic trading. However, most of the agent-based solutions already proposed have not really changed the user's experience, neither have they brought a major shift from traditional activities in classic markets. This is mainly due to their inflexibility. The work proposed combines both, advantages from software agent technology, and from P2P networking technology. The solution has four layers where each one encapsulates a specific set of functionalities: communication, business, cooperation and coordination. Users can adapt or modify the internal structure of one layer without necessarily affecting the others.

articleTitle: Multiple Stepwise Regression Analysis on Knowledge Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Knowledge evaluation is the foundation of knowledge reuse. This paper is aimed at solving the problem of knowledge evaluation in knowledge reuse. It proposed a innovative knowledge evaluation method which is based on iterative multiple stepwise regression analysis theory. This method can help us to identify the remarkable situation attributes and assist us to determine their weight value. Thereby, it implements the knowledge evaluation in knowledge reuse. This method has been applied practically in a requirement engineering knowledge evaluation system. The result shows us that it is feasible to apply the iterative multiple stepwise regression analysis method to the knowledge evaluation.

articleTitle: Status and Analysis of E- Commerce Application in Small Medium Enterprises A Case Study of Wenzhou
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The thesis surveys the status quo of e-commerce application in Wenzhou small medium enterprises. This survey selects the some-100 prominent small medium enterprises covering chemical engineering, shoes, apparel, machinery, furniture, glasses, lighters, pen and pencil, electric and electronics as the investigating targets and issues the questionnaires to them. The result indicates that, the status quo of e-commerce application in Wenzhou small medium enterprises is worrisome, which is obviously way behind other cities. Based on that, the thesis analyzes the reasons in combination with visiting them. It also proposes the corresponding strategies and predicts its prospect in the end.

articleTitle: A New Quantitative Analysis Method for Financial Risk Early Warning of Unlisted Small and Medium Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Although it is practical and significant to analyze the financial risk of the small and medium enterprise (SMEs), most scholars do research on unlisted small and medium enterprisespsila financial situation only with qualitative analysis methods, because it is difficult to get the financial data of unlisted small and medium enterprises. In this paper, a new data acquisition idea is put forward. Through this idea, quantitative analysis method could be taken to study on the financial risk early warning of unlisted SMEs. Data sets of financial risk analysis of unlisted SMEs are selected from listed SMEspsila data sets. Those data sets are disclosed to public and easily obtained. Then listed indicators are omit and decision tree model is made for financial risk early warning of unlisted SMEspsila. 221 listed SMEspsila financial data sets are chosen and models are built in the empirical analysis part of this paper. 30 unlisted SMEspsila financial status (whether in crisis in 2007) have been analyzed by a financial company and the results are generally in line with what are predicted with 30 SMEspsila financial data in 2006 through the models created in this paper. Thus feasibility of the financial risk early warning model is confirmed.

articleTitle: The Design of Mobile E-Business System Based on Open Source Software to Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The third generation mobile systems will be set up in the future not far in China, there are a number of challenges in the mobile e-business of small and medium-sized enterprises (SME). To address this, we present the mobile e-business solution that is enhanced by using external electronic security key and special authentication protocols. Furthermore, we have developed a textile foreign trade mobile e-business system based on open source software for the local textile distributor of China integrating financial, distribution, sales and service processes, given the implement method of overall planning, step-by-step implementation, key breakthrough, and efficiency guiding. In the end, we give all kinds of test case to mobile e-business, and analyze the performance test result in the simulation machine environment, point out the development trend of e-business system based on open source software in the future.

articleTitle: A Semantic Web-Based Enterprise Information Integration Platform for Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: For companies to establish their mobile commerce applications, the fundamental challenge is how to extend existing enterprise applications with mobile functionality in order to provide remote staff with real-time business data while at the same time avoiding alteration of existing system codes. Due to increased diversity of business data and mobile devices, many of current mobile commerce applications are customized applications and serve a specific industry need. In this paper, as a solution to tackle the challenge, we propose an semantic Web based enterprise information integration platform for mobile commerce, which is designed to give developers a systematic reference approach to provide a generic and neutral mechanism to describe and access heterogeneous information resources from existing business applications, support reasoning and auto-discovery of information based on rules, and hide details of underlying wireless networks and mobile devices access from mobile commerce applications.

articleTitle: Analyze and Prevent the Security Risks of E-Commerce Privacy
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper introduces the concepts of E-commerce privacy, security risk of E-commerce privacy, and present status of security risk of E-commerce privacy, analyzes the causes of security risks of E-commerce privacy in six aspects: humanity environment, infrastructure, logical entities, security mechanisms, security services and applications, and gives the corresponding preventive strategies for E-commerce privacy.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Framework for Developing E-Government Emergency System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: A collaborative framework for developing an e-government emergency system is proposed and built. There are abundant information processing mechanisms in the biological endocrine system (BES) including high level regulating mechanism to neural system, the emotional reacting mechanism, and the hormone reaction mechanism. With these mechanisms, BES has the features of self-learning, self-adaptive and self-collaborative etc. By learning the mechanisms in BES, resources and departments collaborate with each other in the e-government emergency system. The concerned respective government departments work together to detect, prevent, respond to, and recover from a disaster, which is consistent with the expectancy theory that maximizes positive outcomes and minimizes negative outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model of E-Commerce Enterprise Image Based on Multi-Granular
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The enterprise image is an abstract, general cognition and appraisal about the enterprise by the social publics, customers and staffs. It is the important intangible asset of enterprises. As a mainstream of commerce forms in the network economy age, e-commerce appears and develops with the improvement of network technologies and exploitation of information resources, which brings huge influences on the traditional production and administration of enterprises. Here, the evaluation of e-commerce enterprise image is investigated based on a multi-granular fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. At first, basing on the traditional evaluation index systems, a new evaluation index system about e-commerce enterprise image is built. Then, a multi-granular fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is designed based on the theory of granular computing, which has more flexible evaluation process. Finally, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of e-commerce enterprise image is constructed. By exercising evaluation on the image of a well-known e-commerce enterprise, the result indicates the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Voice Web Pages for Online Shopping Based on .NET and Streaming Media
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Voice interaction is a conversation mode between human and computer pursued by people. Based on the .NET platform, the techniques of data binding and text to speech are used to create voice homepages at the web sites of online shopping, and the technique of streaming media is used to transfer data, which make it possible to browse text and play voice simultaneously, and even enable a blind person able to listen on line.

articleTitle: Sequence Mining for User Behavior Patterns in Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: User behavior patterns is one of the most essential issues that need to be explored in mobile commerce. In this paper, we propose a new algorithm can efficiently discover mobile users' sequential movement patterns associated in a personal communication systems network. In the first phase of our three phase algorithm, user mobility patterns are mined from the history of mobile user trajectories. In the second phase, mobility rules are extracted from these patterns, and in the last phase, mobility predictions are accomplished by using these rules. The performance results obtained in terms of precision and recall indicate that our method can make more accurate predictions than the other methods.

articleTitle: Positive Periodic Solutions to Singular Second-Order Semi-Linear Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In this paper, we consider the existence of positive periodic solutions to a class of second-order singular semi-linear differential equation, by the fixed point index, we prove that this equation has at least one positive periodic solution with the assumption that the nonlinearity f satisfies super-linear or sub-linear condition which is relevant to the first eigenvalue of the corresponding linear operator.

articleTitle: Decision Analysis of Sequence Multi-Stage IT Project under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This article analyzes the limitation and disadvantages of the current IT investment evaluation methods and studies the problem of multi-stage sequential IT investment decision under uncertainty using dynamic programming method. First, the variation mode of cost and benefit of IT investment is discussed and described with mathematic formulation; second, the decision model for IT investment is developed and extended to the multi-stage sequential IT investment; finally, this model is applied to numerical calculation cases to testify its effectiveness, which provide a quantitative research method for independent or multi-stage sequential IT investment decision under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Assessment on the Adaptivity of Adaptive Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Adaptivity is a major characteristic of adaptive system, and the research about assessment in this area is limited. The authors give an overview about the theoretical background about assessment on adaptivity, summary the difficulties emerging when evaluating, and go further to propose a framework to evaluate the adaptivity.

articleTitle: Analysis of Resources Allocation Efficiency of China's Software Industry Based on Empirical Analysis of China's Eastern Region
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: First, this paper uses the traditional DEA method to measure the resource allocation efficiency of the eastern partpsilas software industry in 2005. Then, by using DEA cross-efficiency to make sort of the software industry resources allocation analysis. The results showed that, on the whole, the resources allocation efficiency of software industry in eastern region is effective; The cross-efficiency of Guangdong software industry is the largest, meaning that the resources input-output ratio of Guangdong software industry achieve the optimal The cross-efficiency of Hebei software industry is minimum, meaning that the resources input-output ratio of Hebei software industry is the worst.

articleTitle: A Novel Pre-segmentation Algorithm of Handwritten Chinese Characters in e-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the development of Chinese E-commerce, handwritten Chinese characters recognition has became an important problem in electronic payment systems and so on. However, the Chinese segmentation is the basis for Chinese character recognition. In the existing Chinese characters segmentation methods, the first step is the presegmentation for Chinese characters image, the second step is further fine segmentation for results of presegmentation, which is a commonly used strategy. Therefore, the pre-segmentation is very important. In order to deal with inefficiency of the traditional algorithms, the paper presented a novel algorithm with pre-segmentation method. Performance analysis and simulation results show that the novel has better efficiency, higher precision and less system cost.

articleTitle: E-government Evaluation Based on Binary Relative Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-government evaluation plays an important role in guiding and inspecting e-government's construction,and it attracts lots of concerns from scholars and governments. In order to remove objective factors' influence on e-government evaluation, the binary relative performance of e-government is proposed with the binary relative evaluation method. Chinese 28 provincial governments' binary relative performances of e-government are measured. The result shows the binary relative performance has incentive to all the governments and makes the evaluation fairer.

articleTitle: Study on Motivation Mechanism of Citizens' Participation under the Conditions of E-government
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This article explores a practical and significant issue on how the public sector should create an effective motivation mechanism to promote actively participation in public decision-making process under the conditions of e-government. First of all, the paper analyses the negative effect of public participation and the significance to encourage citizens to participate under the conditions of e-government. Then, the design principles of the relevant incentive mechanism are discussed. Finally, through the theoretic analysis of incentive function, the paper illuminates how the public sector should chart the correct direction of countermeasure to inspirit citizens to participate.

articleTitle: Review on the Patentability of Business Methods in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In the long history of monopolies, business method can not be patented under the "idea prohibition doctrines". However, business method patents have been a novel and recent edition in practice since the state street decision in the United States Federal Circuit Court of Appeals in 1998. While, in recent years, several reviews have questioned the appropriateness of patenting business methods. This paper reviews the arguments both criticising and defending business method patents and analyses the underlying reasons for the controversy.

articleTitle: The Revenue Model of Online Third-Party Payment Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Based on the game theory, including the prisoner's dilemma game, and clever pig game and dynamic game, the revenue model of online third-party payment in China is analyzed in this paper. And it is proposed that the price competition is inevitable during the initial phrase of online payment development. But the online third-party payment companies can make appropriate business strategy to increase the revenue. For example, the XML-based payment platform can be used to strengthen the infrastructure of online third-party payment construction. Also the differentiated payment products and value-added services like EDI application will enhance the competitiveness of online third-party payment companies.

articleTitle: Research on Model of Biometric Identification Emergency Response in Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This article proposes the concept of complete identity theft, which is possible in the time of electronic commerce of biometric identification. Through the analysis of existing level of identification and its characteristics, this article proposes that there should be the relevant emergency response plan for electronic commerce of biometric identification, and also proposes the framework of biometric identification protocol on PKI and the framework of emergency response application.

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation Based on Ontology Inference in e-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, personalized information service has become one of the hotspots in e-commerce. In this paper, we explore a novel approach to use ontology inference in personalized recommendation, working on the problem of recommending on-line commodity. We organize on-line commodity in terms of ontological classes and using ontological inference as our recommendation algorithm. Ontology inference is shown to improve user profiling, forecast user preference, and enhance recommendation accuracy. The overall performance of our ontological personalized recommendation algorithm presents better compared to other systems.

articleTitle: Credit Risk of Electronic Commerce in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the development of computer technology and economic globalization, electronic commerce will be the main competence means in the 21st century. The paper analyzes the importance of credit as well as type of credit risk of electronic commerce in China. Finally, the paper puts forward measures for risk management .

articleTitle: Security Mechanism to Protect the Integrity of Web Documents
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Web documents which stored in many existed Web servers include Web pages and many resource files such as audios, videos, photos, etc. They are easy to be modified or replaced without necessary secure mechanism. The paper emphasized on the research and implementation of integrity protection mechanism on Web pages by customized middleware which embedded in Web server. The middleware identified the Web document requested by user in time and recovered the modified one according to its importance, which was efficiency to prevent modified documents and Trojan horse scripts from diffusing maliciously. Experiments' results showed that the mechanism could improve the security and reliability of Web system.

articleTitle: The Research of E-Commerce Capability and Business Performance: A Resource-Based View
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In recent rapidly changing environment, electric commerce plays an important role on value chain. Many enterprises have developed Internet programs to ensure their continuous competitive advantage. But how electric commerce impact business performance is still a question. The purpose of the research is to analyze how the e-commerce capability affect firm performance. The paper adopts resource-based view, considers firms should have the new resource and ability to create new e-commerce capability to face the new environment. At last, the paper points out some research directions for the future study related to the capability and business value research from the resource based view.

articleTitle: Qos Multicast Routing Optimization Based on Memetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Qos multicast routing is of great importance for many multimedia communication applications such as videos conference, remote education, CSCW and so on. In order to effectively resolve Qos multicast routing, this paper mainly focus on the bandwidth-delay-constrained least-cost multicast routing problem, and present a memetic algorithm(MA) to deal with this problem. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieves much better performance.

articleTitle: A Study on E-Commerce and Competitive Advantages of an Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-commerce not only affects peoplepsilas life style but also changes the traditional operating mode for an enterprise. In this paper we first introduce that the traditional strategy theory based on Michael E. Porterpsilas competitive strategy model faces severe challenges under the circumstances of e-commerce. And then insightful discussions are focused on how an enterprise obtains competitive advantages in e-commerce mode. Finally, essential suggestions are given to Chinapsilas enterprises for developing e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Aversion of E-Government Network Security
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-government security is a key problem to restrict the construction and development of E-government and other national informatization projects now in China, and how to ensure the E-government network security has already been one of the most important things that must be taken into account whilst in the process of E-government construction. This paper makes an analysis over the security as required for E-government network and discusses emphatically about security technology platform of E-government network security model, risks of security management and assurance system and its risk aversion. Finally it has put forward the utmost concerns in the E-government network security.

articleTitle: A Loss Reportable E-Cash Scheme without TTP Based on ECC
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The E-cash schemes that are revocable anonymous with the help of trusted third party (TTP) cause additional costs and the level of anonymity is uncertain. Kulger et al adopted auditable tracing to control deanonymization without TTP, but the users have to audit the tracing frequently. A loss reportable e-cash scheme without TTP based on ECC is presented in this paper. In our scheme bank demands user to self-decrypt the e-coin when tracing is needed, so that the user and coin can be linked together and then user is certain about tracing. So the scheme resolves the problem of e-cash anonymity control without TTP simply and practically. Moreover, the scheme permit user to report the loss of and recover the lost e-cash, thus user is refrained from economic losses for accident or carelessness.

articleTitle: Is Credit Card Fraud a Real Crime? Does it Really Cripple the E-Commerce Sector of E-Business?
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The Internet, as a powerful worldwide tool for e-commerce, could be, to a great extent, meaningless without the real validity of security, privacy, and the strong role of legislators against credit card fraud. Credit card fraud has been introduced as one of the new concepts that cripples e-commerce improvement, the level of services as well as customerspsila satisfaction in both the private and public sectors. That is, the valuable meaning of e-commerce actually establish on the essence of what provides to its consumers. The different aspects of this matter are highlighted, various concepts concerning e-commerce and its development are discussed A number of e-commerce obstruction are mentioned. Furthermore, e-commerce defenses are presented, some electronic payment systems that used to secure e-commerce transaction are highlighted, and different achieved objectives of distributed questionnaire are presented in many sections.

articleTitle: Developing a Simple Java-Based Mobile Simulation Game
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In recent years, mobile games have gained popularity for providing personal entertainment. With the number of mobile gamers around the world becoming larger and larger, the mobile gaming business generates numerous opportunities for game developers and associated professionals. This paper concentrates on SLG, one kind of most popular games, and tells how to developing a simple example of SLG based J2ME. The structure of the example game is analyzed in details and the transformation diagram of game states is given to help understanding the game process.

articleTitle: On the Peak-Experience in the Game GUI Design
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the era of the dream economy coming, users' requirement become complicated, as well as people' life style has been changed by the culture blend. Thoroughly understanding people, and providing a positive emotional experience to them, is the key to game design. With the magnificent image, well-designed roles and vivid scene, the game interface design brings users the strong sense of presence; carries out the wishes of playerpsilas dream, and offer the peak-experience. Based above, this paper finds out that users dissociates between the true Id and the virtual super-ego, which makes the interaction more extensive. In other words, game GUI design is not only an esthetical form, but an actual practice which needs to create a more effective communication between information architecture and the human user experience. The peak-experience could be attained by the following parts, such as the comprehension of customer psychological model; the efficient communication between users, roles and interface; Realization matchup of the systemic model and psychological model; and other requirements' satisfaction, like emotion and imagination, communication and ascription, challenge and achievement etc.

articleTitle: Analysis on Mobile E-Commerce Value-Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper introduces the content, characteristics and current situation of mobile e-commerce, and points out that building the mobile e-commerce value chain is a practical problem in the development of mobile e-commerce. Using Porterpsilas value-chain theory, it tries to construct a mobile e-commerce value-chain. Then through analyzing the value-chain by SWOT, we can find the strategy of mobile e-commercepsilas development, which would benefit the economic development greatly.

articleTitle: Optimization of Web Service Composition Based on Dynamic Weighted Path Tree
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Increasing the efficiency and accuracy on dynamic optimization choosing of Web service composition is the key point of researching on service composition. In allusion to 1 the way that we use a shortest path based on a weighted tree to describe the Web service composition question, users can set the Qos attribute weight to translate their preference and satisfaction into certain constraints on service composition. We can build an optimal Web service composition path tree through a multi-objective optimization Web service choosing technique, and finally use a low cost shortest path algorithm to achieve better service composition.

articleTitle: A New Decision Making Method under Interval Data Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-business enterprises are faced with many multiple criteria decision making (MCDM) problems, e.g. supplier selection is essentially a MCDM problem. And many complex MCDM problems maybe involve with various types of uncertainties, in such circumstance one is likely to characterize uncertain information as interval data. In this paper a new decision making method based on combining interval data is presented, in which uncertain information is represented by interval data. According to evidence theory, interval data is firstly converted into basic belief assignment (bba) within a binary frame of discernment, then Dempsterpsilas rule of combination can be applied to integrate two interval data. On the basis of interval data combination we propose a new decision making method to synthesize the criteria of each alternative. At last, an example of supplier selection is given to verify the results and show its advantage.

articleTitle: XML Node Semantic Weight Model Based on VSM
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: XML has become an important format for exchange data. Ranking of XML search results directly relates to XML information retrieval performance. Most of the existing ranking models consider words statistical characteristics in the XML document, but they do not consider position of the node a word belongs to. That is to say, all of nodes in XML document have the equal importance. However, different node plays different role in the entire XML document. So, the same content in different node should have different weight. It means different nodes should have different node semantic weight. In this paper, we present a VSM based method for XML node semantic weight (XNSW-VSM), which is scaled by the similarity between the node and the whole document. Experiment data were selected from Wiki data sets. The Pearson correlation coefficient between semantic results given by experts and the model results is 0.827. It shows the node semantic weight model can analyze the importance of node in XML document and it will be helpful for improving ranking results.

articleTitle: Analysis on E-Business's Optimal Behavior Based on Principal-Agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: During researching firms' CIS performance, the e-business's behaviors are an important factor. Based on the principal-agent theory, a linear relation model of E-business behavior and CIS performance is set up, which points out the E-business's optimization decision behavior, the numeral relationships between E-business's optimal efforts, optimal capability and CIS performance. According to it, the right E-business are choose and expected CIS performance is computed definitely through the risk preference of E-business, economic environment expectation and economic environment risk expectation to improve the E-business management level.

articleTitle: Approximate Searching XML Elements Based on Semantic Restrictions
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In last years, XML has become the standard for information representing, exchanging, and publishing. So, querying XML data is a well-explored topic in both database (DB) and information retrieval (IR) fields, which shows proximity search is well suited to XML documents, which are often modelled as labelled trees. Based on the observations that there are some semantic restrictions in userpsilas query, this paper first analysis query restrictions on elements and their values, and then proposes to approximately extract XML elements by using semantic restrictions.

articleTitle: The Electronic Commerce Developmental Strategy of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises under the Network Economic Pattern
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The network economy is the economic activity between the producer and the consumer through the Internet, It may be summarized as a new economic form that establishes on the foundation of computer net, takes the modern information technology as the core. Electronic commerce is the most direct-viewing form. The network economy pattern has provided the unprecedented opportunities for the SME development. Firstly this paper elaborates the connotation and characteristics of network economy and the opportunities which the network economy brings to the SME, then analyzes comprehensively SME's electronic commerce developmental situation, finally proposes the electronic commerce developmental strategies of SME under the network economy pattern.

articleTitle: The Reformation of the C2C Electronic Commerce Transaction Process
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The article analyzes the problems existing in the process of C2C electronic commerce, and put forwards the preferable solutions by the redesigning and recreating of business transaction process. The solutions include: the regulations about the redesigning and recreating; the general transaction service process; the settlement resulting from the buyerpsilas to receive the products; the settlement of disputes arising from the fact that the buyer finds some defects in the products delivered by the seller; promote healthy transaction through the construction of community culture; protect the interests of the Website, the seller, the logistics and the third party etc.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategic Management of Informatization Investment in Small and Medium Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Information technology has become SMEs' dominant factor of survival and development, which not only provides SMEs with the necessary analysis ability of trade and management but also changes enterprisepsilas way of creating value and the method of enterprise management. Based on the analysis of informatization strategy, this article proposed that the core competence and the competitive advantage are footstones of strategy. In virtue of the PDCA model, this paper has put forward several schemes to help SMEs to construct the strategic management of informatization.

articleTitle: Study on Construction Strategy of Community Informatization
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Community Informatization is the important content in the construction of e-government, at the fundamental level between the residents and the government. It is the particular social practice on the basis of social informatization process in China, with the profound social background. In general, community informatization needs experience four construction steps. Combining the present situation, the available construction strategy of community informatization is discussed from three aspects: government promotion, construction mechanism and practical implementation.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Enterprise CA System Based on PKI
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce in recent years, it brings unlimited opportunities for people, but it also gives people a very serious subject, namely, how to ensure security of network. applications. The PKI is a technology platform that can be used to address the problem of e-commerce security effectively. This paper presents a self-built CA system model for enterprise based on PKI, We describe the overall structure and design model in detail, and give specific implementation methods. Compared with other CA system, some features of this system include: open source code based, low cost to achieve, implementation of database technology, excellent compatibility with other enterprise application systems, realization of dual key pairs, separating the signature / authentication key pairs from encryption / decryption key pairs. This enterprise's CA system can preferably solve the authentication, sensitive data transmission and other issues of network security, and promote the process of e-commerce. the application has broad prospects.

articleTitle: An Integrated Framework to Explicate CIOs' Impulsions on Technology Investment
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: CIOs' impulsions on technology investment are a critical factor for the development of enterprises, and the research in this area is limited. The authors give an overview about the theoretical background about the decision-makings, summary the difficulties emerging when CIOs make decisions, and go further to propose an integrated framework to explicate the CIOs' behavior .

articleTitle: Research on the E-Government Scheme Based on Multi-Technologies and Bi-Directional Authentication
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The authentication is the key part of the network security. It is also the main problem we should resolve. This scheme, which is bi-directional, using multi-mechanism to ensure safety authentication and providing a uniform authentication service to other e-government application system, meets the need of current e-government system. But authentication technology and e-government system are continually developing, there are still many problems need to be solved.

articleTitle: Service Capabilities of IT Infrastructure in Chinese Manufacturing Firms
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: By surveying ten best manufacturing enterprises in Shanghai in terms of IT adoptions, the research examines nine classes of total twenty-eight IT infrastructure services employed by these firms. At the end, the IT infrastructure services was analyzed, based on the level, depth, effects and future investment trends.

articleTitle: Mechanism Research for Modern Service Industry Cluster of CAS Based Central City CBD System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: CBD industrial structure in modern sense mainly includes those modern services as finance, software and information service, consulting industry and education, etc. Complex adaptive system theory is one of the achievements for gradually all-round understanding and recognition of complex system, which is aimed at researching how main bodies in complex system adapt to increasingly complex system in the ways of "active learning" and "experience accumulation". The formation process of industrial cluster is also formed by all kinds of main bodies through constant evolution and accumulation. By making use of the complex adaptive system theory, this paper makes analysis to modern service cluster mechanism of central city CBD system, researches to structure of central city CBD system, analysis to CAS features of central city CBD system, and builds model system for evolution dynamic mechanism of modern service industry of central city CBD system.

articleTitle: An RFID-Based Automatic Identification System on Modern Grain Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) is a newly-developed automatic identification technology, superior qualities of which would make it possible to substitute the bar code system in the future. Most importantly, it plays a very important role in the area of logistics. Based on an analysis of the current situation of grain logistics, this paper has studied the applications of RFID technology in each link of grain logistics management, and designed a RFID-based automatic identification system for modern grain logistics.

articleTitle: Risk Prevention Measures for Private Equity in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the development of private equity in China, and points out that the risks of PE contains inherent risks including adverse selection and moral hazard, and external risks including the executive risks, legal risks and withdrawal risks. Furthermore, this paper puts forward risk-preventive methods and suggestions, where the government shall spare no efforts to perfect laws and regulation, improve administrative efficiency, establish an efficient supervision system and multi-level capital market. Meanwhile institutional investors should increase their awareness of risks and prevent the agency risk effectively.

articleTitle: The Effects on Human Resource Management System and Organizational Performance: A Role of Absorptive Capacity
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper constructs a research model integrating Human Resource Management System (HRMS) and organizational performance (OP) from the perspective of absorptive capacity. Based on a theory development, we propose hypotheses between HRMS, absorptive capacity and organizational performance. We obtain 221 effective samples in a snowball sampling manner and testify the sample data with SEM, part of the hypotheses being supported. Both HRMS and organizational performance integration research model based on absorptive capacity have been partially supported empirically. The research direction for future theory development is discussed.

articleTitle: An Economic Analysis and Solutions of Trust Mechanism in E-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the development of Internet, the communication between sellers and customers becomes more convenient. But information asymmetry in e-commerce brings lots of problems about trust because of the virtuality of the Internet. This paper analyzes the trust problems brought by information asymmetry and trust mechanism in e-commerce environment from the point of view of economics. It also discusses the factors of trust mechanism through data-analysis and a model. At last it offers relevant solutions for settling the trust problems and improving the market efficiency.

articleTitle: The Videotex Hot Line Lottery-Ticket-Buying Solution Based on Mobile GPRS System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper raised a visual hot line lottery betting system based on China mobile GPRS. This scheme carries on a certain form of improvement and extension on the foundation of the existing GPRS platform, and it can fulfill the functions of receiving visual information and sending messages to the information terminal. There are three problems solved in this paper: add lottery business flow sever and database in the lottery center; realize the data connection between lottery center and the mobile system platform via DNN, which can ensure the data is deposited in the lottery center; raise the function of visual lottery betting terminal, and extend the lottery betting protocol through GPRS. Different from the existing lottery betting system in China today, this system is also a kind of hot-line betting system, it greatly postpones the deadline of betting, which increases the lottery sale volume.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Mobile Payment Based on J2ME
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Rapidly development of mobile-payment application is dues to the combination of mobile communication and Internet. The combination of J2ME and J2EE technology provides a good solution for mobile- payment. The characteristics of J2ME and J2EE is researched based on mobile- payment platform, and a whole series of solutions are proposed, these solutions can be applied into mobile commerce system of passenger transportation and logistics, and so on. Analyzing and designing the structures function of the mobile- payment system, including J2EE server-tier and J2ME client-tier. At the same time, connecting the database by JDBC and the security of the system, it will give some highlights on the construction of Chinese mobile commerce.

articleTitle: Research on the Solving Scheme of E-Commerce System Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The problems and drawbacks of existing e-commerce systems are discussed in this paper. A new solving scheme for modern e-commerce system framework is presented. And then, the solution of sharing function and data for each node of a modern business flow is designed including data reuse, elastic cart, order of automatic collection, trusteeship calculating of logistics cost request and automatic chamberlain based on Web Services. The new scheme improves the enormous efficiency of commercial affairs.

articleTitle: The Options of Regulators in Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Presently, ineffective supervision of the environmental supervising departments is one of the important cause of the outbreak of much of China's vicious environmental pollution, and inadequate supervision fell into the reasons that the prevalence of local protectionism and the absence of the regulator's responsibility. By constructing a game model and introducing a mechanism of re-supervising, the authors discussed the options of regulators and enterprises under different assumptions and pointed out that it is necessary to monitor the Local Environmental Department to the satisfaction of the National Environmental Department and re-supervising should be carried out effectively.

articleTitle: Formal Descriptive Mechanism of the Ontology Language RDF
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This work illustrates the architecture of semantic Web and data model of RDF, and elaborates on RDF's formal system, whose descriptive mechanism is demonstrated with two examples, including the formalization of relational calculus and logic inference. In the end, it concludes that RDF is a formal specification method, which is a binary relation.

articleTitle: A Novel Data Consistency Algorithm of Mobile E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Data consistency is an important problem for mobile e-commerce networks. Based on the analysis of traditional algorithms, a novel distributed mobile data consistency algorithm called DCAM is proposed for mobile networks. The algorithm, which is constructed with read/write character and based on the token-asking algorithm, utilizes the Lamport's logical timestamps to ensure the time sequence and the validity of control messages. And it reduces the response delay of mobile networks through message multiplexing and distinguishing read/write operation sets. At last, it makes a trade-off between the message complexity and the response delay. Performance analysis and simulation results show that the algorithm can be accommodated to the requirements of mobile E-commerce networks. Compared with traditional algorithms, it has lower message complexity, shorter response delay and better fairness.

articleTitle: The Hybrid MCDM Model for Risk Evaluation in Electronic Commerce Development
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This study applies a hybrid MCDM model for risk evaluation in EC development. First, the risk in EC development is formulated by the combined use of the MCDM (multi-criteria decision making) approach and a proposed five-step hybrid process, which incorporates the technique of ANP (analytic network process) and TOPSIS (technique for order performance by similarity to idea solution). The newly developed ANP will eventually yield the relative weights of the multiple evaluation criteria. Then the TOPSIS is adopted to rank the risk in terms of their overall performances. At last, an example is solved to illustrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the suggested model. The empirical study has demonstrated how the approach can be used for the risk evaluation in EC development.

articleTitle: The Research of Industrial Clusters Development Based on the Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In the network environment, the network development of industrial clusters has high degree fitness with network economy. Enterprises need to orientate themselves again in the role of clusters when industrial clusters analyze the development of from perspective of network economy. This thesis applies virtual organization theory to analyze the impacts of network economy on industrial clusters, discusses the features of industrial clusters, organizational operation modes and competitive advantages of industrial clusters in the network environment, focuses on studying the development strategies of industrial clusters in the network environment, it considers that development strategies of industrial clusters primarily embody on standard information, strengthening diffusion effect, adjusting regional industrial policy, integrating local industrial clusters to global industrial network, preventing risks of industrial clusters and so on when the environment and conditions of birth and development of industrial clusters change.

articleTitle: A Novel Storage Architecture of In-Memory Databases Supporting Real-Time E-commerce Applications
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With growing numbers of suppliers/buyers and the introduction of new additional applications, the simplified and centralized organization of data in the e-commerce systems becomes a focus in reducing operational and capital expenses. With the availability of faster server hardware, network connections and high performance databases, the realization of a common database hosting data for multiple applications becomes technically feasible. However, this kind of deployment will bring new challenges to database systems. One critical challenge is the database should be optimized for real-time accessing databases on large data size. In this report, a novel main memory database architecture based on solid state disks is suggested to meet the requirement. Experiment results shows following benefits can be obtained from the solid state disks: transaction throughput, average response time of write transactions, and database recovery time.

articleTitle: Analysis on E-business's Behaviors of Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper proposes a neural network typology that defines what dependence Chinese enterprises entered in for the global knowledge economy. For organization sustainable development, in this paper, many variables on e-business behaviors were system analyzed and the performance for the e-business application were simulated by BPNN to show the e-business behaviors of 9 complexes level impact on the performance in order to help improve the strategy formulation for development. Empirical analysis was given for various Chinese enterprises and their e-business behaviors. The conclusion showed the relationship between 9 level of the e-business behaviors and the performance of sample enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of Decision Tree Induction Technology in Insurance Data Pretreatment
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper uses the determination tree induction technology to delete the irrelevant attributes (or dimensions) and reduce the data quantity; The decision tree algorithm which at first is used in classification is used to dimensionality reduction, might achieve a higher accuracy, because it optimizes the algorithm measure computation in deletion attribute time. Finally uses the insurance example to explain the application of this method.

articleTitle: A Mechanism Framework for Cluster Enterprise Innovation: A View of Co-Governance
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Since 1990s, there has been a growing concern about the role of industrial cluster in stimulating a regional and in turn a national competitiveness. Especially in the context of emerging technologies and related knowledge-economy business models, linking stakeholders in dynamic clusters is believed to enhance competition and regional innovation (OECD, 1999). Whilst industry cluster contains a huge number of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) varied in the fields of technology, production and marketing, the highlighted issue is to deal with the integrated mechanism of innovation, collective learning, networking and collaboration. By applying a perspective of co-governance, this paper has suggested a functioning framework of innovation mechanism for SMEs, in specific, the four key supporting mechanism - the driving mechanism based on market-oriented governance and internal governance, the learning mechanism based on value chain governance and network governance, the incentive mechanism based on entrepreneur governance, and the constraint mechanism based on government governance - have been analyzed in depth. In addition, the purpose of this paper is to contribute new empirical evidence and theoretical analysis to the given issues through a case study of Xiqiao textile cluster enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Payment in the E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The progress of mobile communication technology and the development of mobile termination promoted the mobilization development of e-commerce. At the same time, mobile payment, being the core technology of mobile commerce, is widely used in handling business transactions. This thesis analyzes the development of domestic and foreign mobile payment, the existent problem. Aiming at the characters of Chinese mobile payment industrial chain, the thesis researches the development trend of mobile payment in China.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment and Consumption Model with One Factor
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The optimal portfolio problem for a bank account, single risky stock is developed. The investment objective is maximizing the utility of the investorpsilas consumption and terminal wealth. The problem has been solved by the stochastic dynamic programming principle. For the constant relative risk aversion utility case, the explicitly optimal investment consumption strategies are obtained. A numerical example is presented.

articleTitle: Antecedents and Consequences of Knowledge Application on Management of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This study develops an integrated model of trust, open-mindedness, knowledge application and organizational performance. We analyze the model using a structural equation model approach, and 208 manufacturing and service firms in China are selected as the samples of this study. The results conclude that: (1) Trust is positively relative open-mindedness; (2) Trust is a function of its knowledge application; (3) Open-mindedness is a function of its knowledge application; (4) Knowledge application will significantly impact on organizational performance. Finally, implications for researchers and practitioners are presented.

articleTitle: The Application of Fragile Watermark in E-Governance
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the application of fragile watermark in e-governance security system. Based on the analysis of the limitation of the text fragile watermark algorithm in the documents integrity authentication, a kind of security system combining digital signature and the fragile watermark is proposed, used the dual password authentication and the content authentication, the security of important documents transmission been greatly enhanced in e-governance.

articleTitle: Research on Neural Network Cost Prediction Model Based on the Rough Sets Theory in ERP
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Whether an enterprise is able to survive during the cruel competition or not is mostly dependent on the cost of investment. Enterprise resource planning (ERP) has been adopting by more and more enterprises and acquires comprehensive admit because it brings out great benefit for the enterprises. A framework of the system coupled by the cost management of ERP is designed. How to design a rough and artificial neutral network is analyzed based on the theory of rough sets with some reduction. The model based rough sets neural network prediction is more efficient and higher precision than BP model in cost prediction.

articleTitle: Design of an E-Procurement System Based on Business Intelligence Tools
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The research proposes an e-procurement system which based on agent technology and OLAP so as to have a better coordination between supply and demand.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing of Perishable Products by Variational Method Facing Rational Consumers
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: By variational method, this paper studies a dynamic pricing problem of perishable products when facing rational consumers. The seller dynamically sets the price for the perishable products to maximize its total profit and the rational consumers choose their consumption pattern to maximize the expected surplus. We present a game theoretic model based on their rational expectations and develop a rational expectations (RE) equilibrium. The equilibrium solution of the game is then studied by variational method. In particular, when the consumption pattern linearly depending on the consumer surplus, we get the right dynamic price by solving the variational problem. The results that followed imply practical recommendations for the sellers when setting the price for the perishable products.

articleTitle: Suggested Choices for the Path to Eliminate Excess Liquidity in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper has defined excess liquidity as lack of transaction ability of financial assets. From this perspective, the author points out that current excess liquidity in China is originated from the internal and external disequilibrium of economic structure, and that current policies aiming at eliminating excess liquidity take little effect because they put too much focus on the gross control. Thus, it is better to "dredge" rather than to "stifle" liquidity. Only by changing from passive gross control to active structural adjustment can we achieve benign interaction between economy and finance, and thus branch off the current excess liquidity in China and fully utilize it as well.

articleTitle: Science and Technology Program Financial Forecast Model Based on Rough Set and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Since entering the 21st century, the funds on science and technology programs invested by the country are increasing year by year with the growing demand for science and technology. So, the assessment of science and technology programs is more and more important, especially the evaluating of financial situation which is a key. This text introduces the theory of rough set and support vector machine to analyze and predict the financial situation of enterprises and set up the financial forecast model. It offers the supervision and management before and after the S&T management sector make decision. Finally, it proves the feasibility and practicability of this model through a practical example.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the Traffic Logistics System Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of national e-commerce economy in China, logistics has gained more high speed of development and abstracted more attentions as "the third profit source". Large-scale production companies and commercial enterprise have set up their own distribution center. The development of the traffic logistics has brought more efficiency of commodity circulation along with some social problem such as resources wastage, traffic safety, environmental pollution and the unloaded motor vehicle rate increase. This paper mainly described the Governmentpsilas Traffic Department how to act as "the third-party logistics" in order to improve their service quality and their service level. Constructing a traffic logistics Website, which makes the vehicle owners and the goods owners to share their information online and effectively reduce the rate of unloaded motor vehicles, and also promote the change of the government's service from the delivery model to the service-oriented one. This paper not only describes various functional modules of system, but also describes the system's core technology. Especially, it used the greedy-backtracking algorithm that is applied to matching subsystem of the vehicles and the goods well. At present, the system has been supported and appraised by the Traffic Department of the Jiangxi Provincial Government and other relevant departments, and has fairly good promotional value in Jiangxi Province and other regions.

articleTitle: Research on the Role of E-education of Universities in Learning Society
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of internet technology, the universities use the modernized internet technology to make the sharp development of high education. This essay begins with the meaning and characteristics of e-education, and analyzes the significant meaning of promoting the implementation of e-education in universities. The essay makes contrast between the development of e-education in China and in other foreign countries according to some aspects: school system, orientation of development, mode of teaching, resources of learning, etc. The essay analyzes the problems occurred in the operation of e-education in the universities, referencing to the experience of foreign countries; furthermore, puts forward some solutions.

articleTitle: On the Legal Status of Electronic Agent in International Trade
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In international business, more and more E-business personnel come to adopt the various intelligent, automated trade systems based on the Internet. This online automated trading system is named legally as E-agent. (electronic agent), which has contributed a great deal to the low cost and high efficiency of international trade by means of its technique and unique function. Meanwhile, it also brings about some legal problems due to the lack of legislation in this realm in China. In oder to better guarantee its greater advantage in international business, this paper ventures to point out some relevant legal regulations of E-agent in those of the UN, America and Canada; analyze three representative views of scholars; finally, put forward some suggestions concerning legislation in E-commerce.

articleTitle: The Appliance of Supply Chain Management Theory to Tourism Development
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Analyzed with the supply chain management theory, the traditional tourism supply chain pattern taking the travel agency as the pattern core is falling behind the new development situation to the tourism, and making many problems on the tourism sustainable development at present. In order to solve the question and catch up the new situation, this article constructs a new tourism supply chain pattern which takes the scenic as the pattern core, and discusses the feasibility.

articleTitle: Design of Lottery Betting Payment System Based on Mobile Terminal
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: There have been 220 million mobile phone users and numerous PDA in our country at the moment, these mobile terminals form the huge potential market of mobile e-commerce which will be the development trend of future e-commerce. Compared with traditional mediums of payment, using mobile terminals, such as mobile phone and PDA, etc to carry out transactions and payments will be more flexible and convenient. A feasible micro payment system is designed and the technical implementation methods of several key functional modules in small and medium payment transactions in the system are given in this paper based on the business projects of mobile phone lottery system.

articleTitle: Research on Tourism E-Commerce Technology Application in the Era of Information Services
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the development of information service, tourism e-commerce is facing more challenges. Through a profound analysis of Chinese current tourism e-commerce, the paper puts forward a tourism e-commerce model based on web service, and probes the application of this model, which realizes information services in Chinese tourism industry.

articleTitle: A New Mobile Information Security Solution Based on External Electronic Key
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Mobile service raises a number of security and privacy challenges. To address this, we present an approach in which the mobile information security is enhanced by using external security key and specified policies. An electronic security key (eKey) is connected to the mobile device by adaptable interface for enhancing the security ability and storing private data. Front end administration module (FAM) located on mobile device which is responded for command initiation connects to backend administration module (BAM) on server by means of identification and mutual authentication which generating different session key with time stamp every time. Furthermore, the software design and hardware design of eKey is given. Software design put emphasis on the security architecture providing security services, based on current relatively mature security framework for wireless mobile terminals of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP). Hardware design put emphasis on the hardware security solution and the communication mechanism between main controller and security module. In this way, the mobile information security problem is solved to a certain extent. In the end, we point the new adapted interface that supports data exchange between mobile terminals and external device will give a large chance to the development and application of eKey in the future.

articleTitle: Factors Impacting Chinese Consumers' Macro-Level Trust on B2C E-Commerce: A Research of Model Development
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Lack of consumers' trust is one of the most frequent cited reasons for consumers not to purchase from Internet shops. In the e-commerce context, based on the trustee, trust can be categorized to macro-level and micro-level. The macro-level trust provides the threshold for customers to enter e-markets. In China, the most important thing is whether or not consumers trust e-commerce environment. Hence, a macro-level trust research model was developed. The model presents the primary relationships between macro-level trust in e-commerce and four groups of main potential antecedents: the hardware and software foundations of Internet, support systems of e-commerce, legal systems of e-commerce, social cultural environment. The individual trust propensity is believed to positively moderate the effect of these antecedents on macro-level trust.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Relevant Legal Issues of Mobile Phone Advertisement
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: From the development status quo of Chinese mobile phone advertisement, this article discusses the development of the SMS (short message service) advertisement, MMS (multimedia message service) advertisement, and the WAP (wireless application protocol) platform. Then, the author analyzes the current problems of the mobile phone advertisement. In these instances, the article makes some countermeasures to improve the mobile phone advertisement market. Finally, the article concludes that mobile phone advertisement has unparalleled advantages in some respects, so it will certainly has a significant development.

articleTitle: Patterns for Designing Experience Oriented 3D Virtual World Learning Applications
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The evolution of 3D virtual world technologies gives opportunity to both 3D virtual world applications such as learning and new programming model in the 3D environment. In this paper, we analyze the business needs for 3D virtual world learning applications, describe the design methodology of virtual learning applications based on our own experience, and summarize the interaction patterns in 3D virtual world, and further derive the new design patterns in the new 3D application environment. With a real case study, we show how the design methodology and pattern are used in the design of 3D virtual world learning applications.

articleTitle: Greetings from the Program Chairs
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Presents the introductory welcome message from the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Green technology and service
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Climate change, rising energy costs and resource constraints are increasing becoming global issues for government and business. These global issues are driving new trends in the development of Green Technologies. Renewable energy sources, advanced water management, efficient resource recycling, waste reduction, intelligent utility networks, intelligent transportation systems, and energy efficiency in data center are gaining strong interests and supports from both the public and private sectors. One of the key initiatives is the application of Green Technology to supply chain management. The objective of this green application is to reduce the carbon emission of company operations. In this talk, we will discuss the new wave of green technology and the emerging services and business on green assessment, diagnosis and consulting, tools and modeling, manufacture process and re-design. We will conclude with our views on future trend, directions and research topics on green technology, green computing, and green services.
